observations.title: Create a party and invite players
observations.player_action: Use the installed FTB Teams GUI or ftbteams party commands for team creation/invitations.
observations.outcome: Players can cooperate through shared team membership and configured permissions.
conditions: Current docs use the party command branch; older project text shows a different create syntax. Use installed help.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: The canonical native team ID/membership and dependent mod's team policy are the signals. FTB party membership must not be silently treated as JEM event participation or map-publication consent.
